title: No DNS CAA record configured for zakerne.com
description: testssl.sh reported no CAA (Certification Authority Authorization) DNS record for zakerne.com. Without a CAA record, any publicly trusted certificate authority is permitted to issue certificates for the domain, offering no defense-in-depth against mis-issuance.
impact: Low likelihood, low-severity gap. Absence of a CAA record slightly increases the theoretical risk of certificate mis-issuance by an unauthorized/compromised CA, since there is no DNS-level restriction on which CAs may issue for the domain.
remediation: Add a CAA record restricting issuance to the CA(s) actually used (e.g. Google Trust Services / Cloudflare's configured CA), e.g. `zakerne.com. CAA 0 issue "pki.goog"`.
